criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Concept has only three prominent cracks and overly equal gaps; use four unequal spaced fractures as prescribed. Correct near-vertical parallel slot appearance with V-tapering bases and variable wall relief. Keep coherent basal ice and quiet intact flats; no extra painted cracks.

Verify Bounded continuous low ice patch with four unequal predominantly transverse irregular crevasses. True deep V-shaped fractures with steep separate opposing ice walls, tapering down to continuous solid ice below. Quiet ice flats between fractures, slightly sloping surface and openly disclosed cut module sides; no square serac grid. Original generic geological process/form module. NPS photo of Middle Teton crevasses is an analog only. No real site replica, precise real crack depth, geological period, flow simulation, current glacial extent or ecosystem asserted. All four boundary sides are intentionally truncated ice section, not natural terminal cliffs.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
